## Describe the Bug
A clear and concise description of what happened.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. File type / container & codec (e.g., 4K MP4 H.264, PNG, WAV)
2. Target format & preset settings selected
3. Browser console output or error message shown in the queue card

## Environment
* **OS:** [e.g. macOS 15, Windows 11, Ubuntu 24.04]
* **Browser & Version:** [e.g. Chrome 130, Firefox 132]
* **Cross-Origin Isolated (`window.crossOriginIsolated`):** [true / false]
* **Approx. File Size:** [e.g. 250 MB]
